info.name: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform Add-Ons Job Templates API

description.content:
The Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform API provides programmatic access to the automation controller for managing IT infrastructure automation. It supports creating and launching job templates, managing inventories, tracking job execution status, and configuring credentials for connecting to managed hosts and external services.
